summary: Static code verification (frontend-only, Expo RN web preview typically non-interactive in headless browser per task note) of three mobile UI fixes: (a) 'More' tab icon changed to 3x3 grid, (b) bottom nav frosted-glass made near-opaque, (c) Help & Support New Ticket modal + ticket chat composer wrapped in react-native-keyboard-controller's KeyboardAvoidingView so inputs rise above the on-screen keyboard. All three changes are present and correct in the referenced files.

1_more_tab_icon_dots_grid.notes: Icon prop is 'dots-grid' (3x3 grid of dots), no longer 'dots-horizontal'. testID='tab-more' preserved.

2_bottom_nav_opaque_blur.notes: Container has testID='app-bottom-nav'. Alpha of 0.94–0.96 combined with blur intensity 90 makes bar effectively opaque, so scrolled content behind it will not be readable.

3a_new_ticket_modal_keyboard_avoiding.evidence: import { KeyboardAvoidingView } from 'react-native-keyboard-controller'; <Modal ...><KeyboardAvoidingView style={{flex:1, ..., justifyContent:'flex-end'}} behavior="padding" keyboardVerticalOffset={0}>...ticket-subject / ticket-message inputs...</KeyboardAvoidingView></Modal>
3a_new_ticket_modal_keyboard_avoiding.notes: Correct package (react-native-keyboard-controller, not react-native core). Wraps entire bottom-sheet including both TextInputs (ticket-subject, ticket-message). behavior='padding' will lift the sheet above soft keyboard on native.

3b_ticket_chat_composer_keyboard_avoidin.evidence: import { KeyboardAvoidingView } from 'react-native-keyboard-controller'; <KeyboardAvoidingView style={{flex:1}} behavior="padding" keyboardVerticalOffset={0}> ...ScrollView of messages + composer with testID='ticket-reply'... </KeyboardAvoidingView>
3b_ticket_chat_composer_keyboard_avoidin.notes: Composer input ticket-reply is inside the avoiding view, so it will rise above the keyboard when focused on native.

runtime_interaction_test: Skipped intentionally. Per review request note: 'This is a NATIVE Expo React Native app served on web via expo web ... If the web preview renders blank or is non-interactive (common for this native app in headless browser due to font/native-module gating), report that clearly and instead STATICALLY verify the three code changes.' No EXPO_PACKAGER_PROXY_URL / REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL for a browser preview is exposed in the container env, and native soft-keyboard avoidance cannot be exercised in a headless browser. Static verification against the referenced files is therefore the correct checkpoint for these three items.
critical_code_review_comments: AppTabBar.tsx: 'dots-grid' assumes the MdiName type accepts this key. If TypeScript flags it, ensure the icon name is registered in the Icon component's whitelist — otherwise fallback rendering may occur on native.

support/index.tsx line 133: KeyboardAvoidingView is used as the root child of <Modal>. On some Android configurations the modal may already handle inset resize (windowSoftInputMode). If double-adjust behavior appears on Android, consider gating behavior per Platform (behavior={Platform.OS === 'ios' ? 'padding' : undefined}) — non-blocking observation only.
support/[id].tsx: keyboardVerticalOffset={0} is fine because there is no fixed top header offset issue here (AppHeader is inside the same View but above the KAV). Confirmed correct.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All three UI fixes are present in code. Runtime verification on native (Expo Go / device build) is still recommended by main agent since keyboard avoidance behavior cannot be validated in the headless-browser expo-web preview. Test IDs to use on native runtime: tab-more (grid icon), app-bottom-nav (opaque bar), support-header, new-ticket, ticket-subject, ticket-message, ticket-reply.
